title: Wildfire early-departure trigger
summary: Define departure triggers before smoke, congestion, nightfall, heat, or road closures remove safe options.
content: Field sequence: Link an official warning, nearby fire behaviour, falling ash, visibility loss, vulnerable-person need, or route deterioration to immediate movement on the preselected route.
